label: Concurrent event ingestion — 1M single INSERTs across 10 threads into cassandra_naive.events. One shared thread-safe Session (Cassandra driver model). Prepared statement shared across threads. No per-thread connection setup — driver pool handles concurrency. autocommit equivalent: every INSERT is immediately durable at LOCAL_ONE consistency. No FK constraints — no staging table needed. CSV: events_q8.csv (pre-generated, fixed seed).
